Name: More Dim Sum
Author: Yuzu17
Description:
[b][color=#ffd966][size=5][font=Courier New]UPDATE on 10/30/2026[/font][/size][/color][/b]
[size=4][font=Courier New][b]Shared ingredients have moved to Yuzu [color=#ffd966]More Ingredients[/color], and the Secret Woods Shrimp Trap has moved to Yuzu [color=#ffd966]More Craftables[/color].
Please install both mods and their requirements when updating. More Dim Sum contains the dim sum dishes and their recipes. You don’t need to install the other More food mods.
[color=#e69138]Remove the old More Dim Sum folder before installing the updated version to avoid leaving outdated files behind.[/color][/b][/font][/size]



[b]
[color=#ea9999][size=5][font=Courier New]New ingredients & items[/font][/size][/color][/b]
[size=4][font=Courier New][b][color=#d4d4d8]1. [/color][color=#ffd966]Secret Woods Shrimp[/color][color=#d4d4d8] : Can only be caught in the lake in the Secret Woods. [/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]2. [/color][color=#ffd966]Secret Shrimp Trap[/color][color=#d4d4d8] : Craft one first. Place it in the lake in the Secret Woods to catch Secret Woods Shrimp. [/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]3. [/color][color=#ffd966]Secret Woods Honeyed Chestnut[/color][color=#d4d4d8] : Forageable in the Secret Woods. [/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]4. [/color][color=#ffd966]Rice Flour[/color][color=#d4d4d8] [/color][color=#d4d4d8]: Mill Rice into Rice Flour. One Rice produces three Rice Flour. [/color][/b][/font][/size]



[font=Courier New][b][color=#00ffff][size=5]Installation instructions[/size][/color]
[/b][/font]
[list=1]
[*][font=Courier New][b][font=Courier New][b][size=4]Download and unzip the file.[/size][/b][/font][/b][/font][/*]
[*][font=Courier New][b][font=Courier New][b][size=4]Place the extracted folder directly into your Stardew Valley Mods folder.[/size][/b][/font][/b][/font][/*]
[*][font=Courier New][b][font=Courier New][b][size=4]Keep the folder structure as it is.[/size][/b][/font][/b][/font][/*]
[/list][font=Courier New][b][color=#ff0000][size=4]Do not move or extract the individual mod folders from their parent folder.[/size][/color][/b][/font]
